# Linux Sudo Root Shell
# id: 77ac898a-1fb3-45ef-b980-a837cbb837c3
# source: rules/linux/sudo_to_root_shell.yml
# format: Elasticsearch Lucene
# Field names are the Sigma field names. No product pipeline was applied.
# Generated by python3 -m rulelab convert. Do not edit by hand.
(process:sudo AND message:*USER\=root\ ;*) AND message:/COMMAND=(\/usr)?\/bin\/(su|bash|sh)( |$)/ AND (NOT (message:(*authentication\ failure* OR *incorrect\ password* OR *NOT\ in\ sudoers* OR *command\ not\ allowed*)))
